waze.comment: Show Waze map inside the theme (shared/waze.js): waze-on-cluster's status file (read every second) and its control socket (one short 'start' command, then closed). Paths from waze-on-cluster 0.9.3.

cluster_themes._comment: target panel: the whole 1920x720 instrument cluster, drawn over BMW's gauges. socketPath: cluster-render's documented default. utcOffsetMinutes: as in HUD Widgets (the clock box). tankLitres: the fuel gauge's full mark (the car sends litres, not the tank size; a G01 X3 holds 65). engine: the peak crank torque (Nm) and power (kW) the {{torquePct}} and {{powerPct}} tokens count from (an M40i: 500 Nm, 285 kW / 382 hp).

dme.comment: Boost from the engine unit (DME, ecu 18) over read-only UDS 0x22, only while the sport display sends no boost and a boost readout is shown. Absolute kPa, the outside air pressure (baro) is subtracted. Candidates tried in order, the first plausible one wins. From cauliflowermossgrape's car_vitals (MIT). Intake air temperature the same way (config.dme.intake, every 2 s, only while an intake readout shows); candidates from cruzen991/Cluster's signal table (MIT), unverified on this car.

boost.note: OBD PID 0x70 boost pressure control: actual boost pressure sensor A (absolute), 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x87 intake manifold absolute pressure sensor A, 1/32 kPa
OBD PID 0x0B intake manifold absolute pressure, kPa (max 255 = 1.5 bar boost)

baro.note: OBD PID 0x33 barometric pressure, kPa (101.3 when not available)

intake.note: OBD PID 0x0F intake air temperature, C + 40
OBD PID 0x77 charge air cooler temperature, bank 1 sensor 1 (byte after the support byte), C + 40
